title: onprem-airgap-offline-bundle-vendor-rke2-suse-microos-almalinux-support
author: Avery Chen
description: Adds an updated on-prem/offline bundle vendor and installer support for RKE2 clusters on SUSE MicroOS and AlmaLinux 9. Motivation: customers running regulated/private deployments requested first-class support for these distros (ENG-9382). This PR vendors the following: 1) container images required by the installer and system services into a vendor tarball; 2) OS-level packages and repositories for SUSE MicroOS (transactional-update styled layout) and AlmaLinux/Yum repos; 3) updated TUF metadata and signing keys used by the offline bundle; 4) Helm chart tweaks to support sysctl and EFI boot detection on SUSE; 5) a small rollback helper that can restore previous TUF root metadata when post-install verification fails. Summary of changes: - packaging: build/offline-bundle scripts extended to produce vendor-rke2-suse-almalinux.tar.gz - vendor/ directory: added image index YAML and repo snapshots for microos & almalinux - helm/redwood-installer: added values and conditional templates for microos (systemd-oomd, transactional) and repo config - tuf/: refreshed root.json and delegated timestamp/meta for offline validation - scripts/rollback-tuf.sh: idempotent restore path and verification checks - docs/airgap.md: added distro-specific notes and troubleshooting checklist Checklist: - [x] vendor tarball builds reproducibly in CI - [x] TUF metadata signed and verified in build pipeline - [x] Helm chart dry-render passes with new values - [x] E2E airgapped install tested on VM clusters (RKE2) - [x] Rollback script tested to restore metadata on failed verification Testing performed: CI pipeline for offline-bundle (unit + integration image presence), airgap e2e in gated lab for both SUSE MicroOS and AlmaLinux 9, manual validation of TUF verification scenarios including key rotation and rollback. Upgrade/rollback notes: the installer will attempt to verify TUF metadata before proceeding; if verification fails the rollback script can be invoked to restore the last-known-good root.json and re-run verification. Customers upgrading from older bundles must re-run the bundle-importer with --reconcile to pick up repo layout changes. Docs updated with migration steps. Related: SUP-447 for customer repro, ENG-9382 for distro support work.
